title: feat(pm): H72 lists unlisted mailbox knocks against the seat roster
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi994eAZcnCC5xnunA1cufNQ1)_
Part of #34013

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** 半态巡查的信箱行(H72)现在每轮用已列出的在任座位贴与信箱开张读一次席位名册,交给同一个敲门读取器;签名会话不在所点名席位名册上的敲门(`unlisted`),在该信箱上多出一行只报告的巡查行,按评论 id 列出,告诉收信席位「这条不照办」。
- **为什么改:** 上一 PR 落了 `listed`/`unlisted` 读数,但巡查没带名册,`unlisted` 敲门没人被告知(卡上席位裁定的剩余项一)。
- **风险与回滚:** 只改 PM 工具两个脚本,产品包零改动、不发布;不新增任何请求(名册读自巡查已有的两份列表);名册读不全(列表触页上限)时整行不判、摘要写 NOT MEASURED,不会误报。回滚即 revert。
- **先看:** `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` 的 `h72UnlistedKnockLines` 与 `h72RosterListings`,以及 sweep 里 H72 块的接线(`mailboxEvents(rows, roster)`)。
- **两分钟验证:** `node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test`,预期结尾 `H72 mailbox off-table bells 36/33`、退出 0。
- **需要你做的:** 无,席位落地。剩余项二(卡线程会话是否入席位名册)未在本 PR 处理,见下文 Remainder,卡保持打开。

## What changes

- **The roster, once per sweep.** H72's sweep block now imports `seatSessionRoster` beside `mailboxEvents` (same lazy import) and reads the roster from the two listings the sweep already holds: the open `pm:seat` posts (`SEEN_LABEL_PAGES`) and the open pulls (H7's listing). No new request, and no second signature or roster parser in this file (pinned against the source above the self-test).
- **`h72RosterListings(issues, pulls, truncated)`** (pure): hands the roster the `pm:seat` rows and the pulls, or `null` for a listing that `noteOpenListing` recorded as truncated at the page ceiling (or that is not an array). The roster reads `null` as `unreadable`, never as a smaller roster: a partial roster would read a knock from a seat whose post sat on an unread page as `unlisted`. The two listing names live in `H72_ROSTER_LISTINGS` and are pinned against the names the two listing functions record.
- **`h72UnlistedKnockLines(reading, roster, nowMs)`** (pure): a second report-only H72 row on the mailbox PR, listing (up to five, then counting) the knocks inside the 24 h window whose signature reads `unlisted`, by comment id, author and the reader's reason. Remedy text: the seat the mailbox serves does not act on an `unlisted` knock (`untrusted-text.md`); the seat the signature names rings from a session it lists (`--mailbox-keys` prints the rule). A `listed` knock is a consistency reading, never proof, and is not listed. A maintainer's knock (not signature-checked) and a comment the author fence ignores are out.
- **Unjudged, never clean.** A roster that was not read makes the reader fail closed, so every relay knock reads `unlisted`; this row then lists nothing and the sweep records `mailboxRosterReason`, which the H72 summary clause renders as `Unlisted knock signatures: NOT MEASURED — …`. The new key rides `SWEEP_COUNT_KEYS`.
- The off-table row (`h72OffTableMailboxLines`) is unchanged and reads the same `mailboxEvents(rows, roster)` reading; its census does not move with the roster (pinned by #34071).
- Band stays `inventory`; neither row is loud.

## Tests

- `check-half-states.mjs` H72 battery: 22 → 36 cases, floor raised 20 → 33. Both ways: an `unlisted` knock fires; `listed`, maintainer and unsigned readings do not; an unread roster (unreadable, null, no `state`) and an unread reading are unjudged; the window boundary (23h59m fires, 24h01m aged out, unreadable `at` fires); an off-table unlisted knock is named by both rows; the five-item cap; the text (no angle bracket, rule file, printout, never proof, report-only, no tracker number); not loud; the roster listings and their truncation; the truncation names against the listing functions' source; the sweep wiring against the source above the self-test; the summary clause in both states and the forwarding key.
- `record-recognisers.mjs` knock-signature battery: 2 end-to-end rows. The REAL roster read through `h72RosterListings` (with a non-seat card and a non-mailbox pull mixed in) and the REAL reader: H72 lists the stray session's knock and not the listed knock, the maintainer's or the drive-by's. A truncated `pm:seat` listing makes the real roster unreadable, the reader reads both relay knocks `unlisted`, and H72 lists none.
- Self-tests at 22ea9fe0: `check-half-states` 5307 cases pass; `record-recognisers` 432 cases pass. No forced edits to existing tests.

<details><summary>Ablations — 3 legs, each red, each restored to the HEAD blob</summary>

All through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1, x1 to x0) at 22ea9fe0; each restore proven by an empty `git diff HEAD` and blob `e1e8c12b` equal to HEAD.

| leg | mutation | red cases |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A1 | drop the unread-roster guard in `h72UnlistedKnockLines` (`roster === undefined` only) | 1 in check-half-states (unjudged roster), 1 in record-recognisers (truncated listing end-to-end) |
| A2 | the sweep calls `mailboxEvents(rows)` without the roster | 1 (wiring pin) |
| A3 | `h72RosterListings` ignores a truncated `pm:seat` listing | 1 in check-half-states (truncation), 1 in record-recognisers (truncated listing end-to-end) |

A first A2 attempt was refused before any write (anchor ambiguous: it also matched the pin's own literal); it ran with the indented sweep line as the anchor.

</details>

## Remainder (not in this PR — the card stays open)

- **Does a card-thread session named on a seat's newest `Claim:` belong on that seat's roster?** Not done here, for a measured reason: there is no claim reader of a thread session on `main` to reuse. `claimSessionId` reads the FIRST session on the `Session:` line, deliberately the seat's; nothing reads `Thread session:`. The claim template in the pm-dispatch skill carries no such key, and live claims spell it at least three ways: a `Thread session:` line (the skills seats' claims), a second session in prose on the `Session:` line (a spec seat's), or not at all (a ui seat's claim for a card set; a server seat's subagent claim). Listing it would mint a new claim key and its reader. The options are in the card's `os-dev-report`.

## Acceptance notes

- No live census of today's `unlisted` knocks was taken: this card thread does not run the board sweep. The previous round's census (22 of 58 relay knocks `unlisted` on 2026-11-15) is the expected order of magnitude for the new row on the first sweeps.
